name: Puri The Aravallis
summary: Project, developer (Puri Constructions), Sector 61 GCER location, RERA GGM/592/324/2022/67, under-construction status and the 2,250 / 2,750 sq ft 3 and 4 BHK units are confirmed; the starting price is within range of some quotes. Major issue: Square Yards, PropertyPistol and official application material give possession June 2029, against our December 2026; some broker sites cite August 2026 'as per HRERA', so sources conflict. Tower and unit counts also differ: sources say 2 towers with 324 (or 640) units, not 4 towers with 320 units.

June 2029 (Square Yards, PropertyPistol; Phase-I completion on or before 30 June 2029 per official application material); August 2026 'as per HRERA document' (luxuryresidences.in); December 2028 on one other site
